reason: Both correctly identify normal induction pan vibration and avoid any unsupported part or fault claims. Conversation 1 earns credit for asking the sensible first-step questions (lower power, pan check) and confirming from the answers, but its boilerplate safety panel about tripping electrics is irrelevant and it never addresses the fan run-on or gives clear 'when to worry' criteria. Conversation 2 covers the sandwich-base cause precisely, pre-empts the fan whir as normal, gives the 'try a different pot' test, and sets out concrete escalation triggers (codes, noise with every pan, burning, cracked glass), which more fully equips the homeowner despite not iterating with questions.
